Answered plainly.

Ask us anything Leave your number and we'll call you back.

01Money

01 What does the ₹1,499 include?

A private session in the room for up to 4 guests, with the screen, sound and seating. Additional guests are ₹300 each within room capacity. Decor, food, flowers and other extras are priced separately, and taxes and applicable charges are additional.

02 Does pre-booking cost anything?

No. Pre-booking is free and takes no payment — it tells us which dates and experiences people want. We call you to confirm availability, and nothing is charged until you've confirmed your booking with us directly.

03 When and how do I actually pay?

After we've spoken and confirmed your slot. We'll tell you the exact amount on that call, including taxes and anything you've added. Nothing is taken through this website.

04 Will the price change after I book?

Not unless you change the booking. If you add guests, decor or food later, we'll tell you what it costs before we add it.

02The room

05 Is the room really private?

Yes. For the length of your session the room is reserved for your group only — no shared seating and no other bookings running alongside yours.

06 How many people can come?

The base price covers up to 4 guests, and you can add more at ₹300 each up to the room's capacity of 12. Tell us your group size when you pre-book and we'll confirm it fits.

07 How long is a session?

2 hours 30 minutes, from the time your slot starts. If you need longer, ask us — if the slot after yours is free, we can usually work something out.

08 Can we choose what to watch?

Yes — bring whatever you want to play, and we'll help you get it on the screen. Please make sure you have the right to play it.

03Bringing things

09 Can we bring our own cake, food or decor?

Tell us what you're planning when you pre-book and we'll confirm what's allowed. We also offer cake, food and decor as add-ons if you'd rather we set it up.

10 Can we decorate the room ourselves?

Usually yes, within reason and within your session time. Check with us first so we can tell you what won't work with the room or the equipment.

11 Can we take photos and video?

Of your own group, as much as you like. We also offer a 15-minute photo shoot as an add-on.

04Plans changing

12 Can I reschedule or cancel?

Yes. Tell us as early as you can and we'll move your slot if one is free. The full terms are on our cancellations page.

13 What if I'm running late?

Call us. Your slot has a fixed end time because of the booking after yours, but we'll do what we can.

05Finding us

14 Where are you, and when are you open?

We're in Jabalpur and opening soon. Pre-book now and we'll share the exact address and your confirmed slot when we call you.

15 Can I see the room before I book?

Once we're open, yes — just ask on the call. Before that there isn't much to see, so we'd rather not waste your trip.
